title: Bridging the gap between performance and interpretability: An explainable disentangled multimodal framework for cancer survival prediction.
snippet: While multimodal survival prediction models are increasingly accurate, their complexity often reduces interpretability, limiting insight into how different data sources influence predictions. title: Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome: A Brief Review.
snippet: Polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) is a prevalent endocrine disorder affecting 10-13% of reproductive-aged women. Characterized by hyperandrogenism, ovulatory dysfunction, and metabolic disturbances, its management is increasingly focused on the gut-brain-ovary axis and chronic low-grade inflammation.
